verses.english: Desire, Etc. for the Not-Self Interior

verses.pali: “Yo, bhikkhave, anattā, tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should give up desire … greed … desire and greed for what is not-self.

verses.pali: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo …pe…
verses.english: The eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are not-self …”

verses.pali: jivhā anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo …pe…
mano anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
Yo, bhikkhave, anattā tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
